name: dsh-skin-win2003
description: Windows Server 2003 skin for the DSH Web GUI: metric-accurate grey chrome, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, square corners and a 16px scrollbar. 给 DSH Web GUI 换上 Windows Server 2003 经典外观。
